scripts.railway:build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.railway:build:auto: sh -c 'if [ "${RAILWAY_APP_TARGET:-${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-frontend}}" = "backend" ]; then npm run railway:build:backend; else npm run railway:build:frontend; fi'
scripts.railway:start:auto: sh -c 'if [ "${RAILWAY_APP_TARGET:-${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-frontend}}" = "backend" ]; then npm run railway:start:backend; else npm run railway:start:frontend; fi'
